subject.title: feat: support GCP broker metadata auth

question: After the changelog defect is removed, must the final head complete a full metadata-auth create/use/delete lifecycle with the documented IAM and access scope, or is the existing live token and Compute API proof sufficient?
rationale: The evidence proves real metadata-token acquisition and Compute API access, but only maintainers can set the release threshold for the remaining security-sensitive lifecycle proof.

options.title: Require full lifecycle proof
options.body: Hold merge until final-head metadata auth creates, uses, and deletes a GCP lease with a correctly scoped attached service account.

options.title: Approve a proof waiver
options.body: Accept the existing live metadata-token and Compute API evidence after confirming the final runtime code matches the proven path.

recommendation.title: Require full lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until final-head metadata auth creates, uses, and deletes a GCP lease with a correctly scoped attached service account.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the provider path and directly drove this branch's hardening and proof reviews.
